Goal — wired up. Three entries added to @tools in ToolRegistry:

1. `read_inbox` → Tools.Messages.read_inbox/0 (no params)
2. `read_message` → Tools.Messages.read_message/1 (param: id)
3. `send_message` → Tools.Messages.send_message/3 (params: to, task_id, parts)

Also updated the system prompt and CLI help text so the LLM knows these tools exist.

Design note: I registered only the three required params for send_message (to, task_id, parts). The optional keyword opts (from, expects_response) use sensible defaults (from="code", expects_response=false). The execute/2 function passes args positionally, so keyword opts don't map cleanly to the registry format. If we need the LLM to set from/expects_response, I'll add a thin wrapper function — but for now the defaults are correct for Code's use case.
